name: John G. Schmitz
summary: John George Schmitz (August 12, 1930 – January 10, 2001) was an American politician who served as a Republican member of the United States House of Representatives and California State Senate from Orange County, California. He was also a member of the John Birch Society. In 1972 he was the candidate for president of the United States of the American Independent Party, later known as the American Party.
